name: agent-memory
description: Long-term memory from a self-hosted Agent Memory server: recalls relevant memories before each prompt and captures each finished turn (tool calls included, secrets redacted).

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Agent Memory server, e.g. https://memory.example.com. Leave empty to use `amem login`.

user_key.title: User key
user_key.description: Your sk-mem-… user key from the Memory Panel. Leave empty to use `amem login`.

team_id.title: Team ID
team_id.description: team_… of a team you belong to. Leave empty to use `amem login`.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: agt_… of an agent in that team. Leave empty to use `amem login`.
